sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) as total_consumption FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' AND c.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID), min_per_segment AS (SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) as min_cons FROM customer_totals GROUP BY Segment), lowest_customers AS (SELECT ct.Segment, ct.total_consumption, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM customer_totals ct JOIN min_per_segment mp ON ct.Segment = mp.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mp.min_cons GROUP BY ct.Segment, ct.total_consumption), annual_avg AS (SELECT Segment, total_consumption * 1.0 / cnt as annual_average FROM lowest_customers) SELECT 'SME-LAM' as diff, (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') as difference UNION ALL SELECT 'LAM-KAM', (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') UNION ALL SELECT 'KAM-SME', (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
